summary: SiteDocument represents the document entity associated with a Site, primarily containing its ID and the SiteID it is assigned to. It is used as a data model in the system.
purpose: To encapsulate information about documents that are attached to a site within the HSPnet system, providing a means for associating and retrieving documents based on SiteID.
system_behavior: SiteDocument objects are instantiated and their data retrieved or assigned via system methods.
content_gaps: No information available about full workflows, actors, or business rules interacting with SiteDocument. No explicit description of document upload, retrieval, or deletion.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin presents a user interface for staff administrators to view last login, select sites and disciplines, filter employment applications by date, and review submitted or withdrawn applications. The page also handles messages, errors, and warnings.
purpose: To provide staff administrators with an overview and controls for managing employment applications across sites and disciplines, including filtering, refreshing, and viewing application status.

workflows.name: View Employment Applications
steps: StaffAdmin loads WelcomeStaffAdmin page
Last login and timezone are displayed
Site and discipline dropdowns are populated based on UserSession
Start and end dates are defaulted to a recent range
StaffAdmin can filter by site, discipline, dates, show withdrawn
RefreshData is called on changes to filters or refresh button
Employment applications are bound to grid view for review
Applications include links for name, email, status, and withdrawn date

business_rules: Withdrawn applications are indicated in status and withdrawn date fields
Filtering is allowed by site, discipline, start and end date, withdrawn status
conditions: Show withdrawn checkbox controls inclusion of withdrawn applications
Page default button set to RefreshView
system_behavior: Dropdowns are populated using Disciplines.DisciplineList and Sites.GetByAgencyID
GridView applications databinding is triggered by filter changes
Page messages and warnings are handled and displayed
Employment application entries provide links and tooltips
exceptions: If UserSession is missing, dropdowns are not populated
content_gaps: No explicit definition of the EmploymentApplication data model
No information about application review or approval workflows beyond filtering and viewing

summary: ServiceCode is a data entity representing a service's code and associated metadata. ServiceCode objects are used for lookup, display, and filtering in connection to Courses and Timetables.
purpose: To model service code information including category, name, alt-language name, notes, and sort order, and to facilitate service code retrieval for courses and timetables in the HSPnet system.

workflows.name: Retrieve Service Codes for Course
steps: Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID with session and CourseID
Procedure 'ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID' returns results
ServiceCode entries are populated and localized if alt-language enabled
Return list for use in UI or business logic

workflows.name: Retrieve All Service Codes
steps: Call ServiceCodeListAll with session
Procedure 'ServiceCodeListAll' returns all service codes
Entries are localized and returned as a list

workflows.name: Retrieve Service Codes for Timetable
steps: Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID with session and TimetableID
Procedure 'ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID' returns results
ServiceCode entries are populated and localized
Return list

business_rules: If UseAltLanguageFields is true, Name is replaced with NameAlt
conditions: ServiceCode retrieval behavior changes based on UseAltLanguageFields boolean
system_behavior: ServiceCode objects are instantiated from database reader
content_gaps: No information on who updates ServiceCodes or how they are validated

summary: SiteProfileHistory records audits of changes made to site profiles, including metadata about the user, agency, action date, and which fields were modified.
purpose: To track and display historical changes to Site profiles, including who made changes, when, and what was changed, for auditing and review purposes.

workflows.name: Site Profile History Search
steps: Call SiteProfileHistorySearch with SiteID, SessionAgencyID, and UserSession
Procedure returns SiteProfileHistory entries
Entries are populated with audit data, including localized fields if enabled
History grid is displayed to user with formatted names and agency details

business_rules: Name, UserAction, and Fields are localized if UseAltLanguageFields is enabled
calculations: ActionDateFormatted: ActionDate converted to short date string
AgencyUserFormatted: Constructed from agency and initials
conditions: If ByUserSysAdmin is false and ByUserID not equals to ByOriginalUserID, Support Team for caption is added
system_behavior: SiteProfileHistory objects populated from database via FillList
Tooltip provides formatted name with agency and phone
content_gaps: No information on who can access SiteProfileHistory or how audits are triggered

summary: EmailPopupDocument models file attachments for use in Email popups, including their file name, path, and checked status. Also, deletion and search mechanisms for these documents are provided.
purpose: To provide a means for associating, managing, and deleting file attachments in email popups within the system.

workflows.name: Search EmailPopupDocuments
steps: Call Search with DataInfo string
Splits DataInfo into entries
Populates EmailPopupDocument with ID, FileName, FilePath, Checked
Returns list for use in Email popups

workflows.name: Delete EmailPopupDocument
steps: Call Delete with DataInfo and ID
Finds document by index
Deletes file and associated directory
Returns new DataInfo string without deleted entry

system_behavior: Document list is populated from delimited DataInfo string
Files and folders are deleted on user request
Safe deletion is attempted, exceptions are ignored
exceptions: Deletion failures are caught and ignored
content_gaps: No information on who can add, check, or retrieve documents, or how files are uploaded
